summary: The exact candidate is valid test-only hardening for a production ownership guard already present on the recorded base. Its four GPU cases pass, fail specifically for borrowed inputs when the guards are temporarily removed, and an independent shared-gate-style caller reuse check passes. The candidate itself adds no production fix, and the reported full Qwen3.5 TP8/EP8 CUDA workload remains unverified.

tests.what_was_measured: Exact candidate regression on the assigned gfx950: compact/masked crossed with inplace false/true; 4 passed.

tests.command: same pytest command after temporarily replacing both runner_config.inplace guards with unconditional disposal
tests.what_was_measured: Original ownership failure reproduced: both inplace=False cases collapsed the caller tensor to shape [0], while both inplace=True cases passed.

tests.command: same pytest command with a temporary independent BF16 linear-plus-sigmoid caller-reuse assertion
tests.what_was_measured: Shared-expert-like reuse after pre-permute matched a preserved reference for compact and masked inplace=False paths; all 4 cases passed.
CPU-only collection is blocked in this ROCm environment because an SGLang import probes torch.cuda device properties when no GPU is visible.
Candidate changes only one Python regression test and report artifacts; no production or native source changed.

gpu_execution.evidence: Tests imported /job/repo/python/sglang/srt/layers/moe/moe_runner/deep_gemm.py and executed GPU tensors on one AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950 using Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2.

remaining_limitations: The candidate is test-only and does not itself introduce the production fix; the prepared base already contains the ownership guards.
Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-FP8 weights, eight H800 GPUs, CUDA 12.x, and TP8/EP8 were unavailable, so the reported full serving failure and fix were not run.
Packing kernels are mocked, so the regression establishes Python ownership behavior rather than DeepGEMM numerical correctness.
CPU-only test collection is blocked by a GPU property probe in this ROCm build's SGLang import path.
